newfold_gov_kag_provenance.ai_message: Two reasons it stayed local. newfold_gov_routing_logic.ai_message: Three gates. First, is it safe to send: any field carrying PII or PCI stays in the SLM, always. Second, is it worth sending: a task uses the frontier model only when it needs reasoning or generation the SLM cannot do reliably. Third, is it within budget: if a user or agent has hit its cost ceiling, non-critical tasks stay on the SLM even if they would otherwise qualify. A task has to pass all three. Everything else stays local.
